description: Compiles and runs F0609A (06-09, monitor/on-error/on-exit/psds around a deliberate zero-division). Per this session's own design revision, F0609A's record-lock demonstration was deliberately moved OUT of the automated pipeline (a real 2-session lock-contention test cannot be reproduced within one verify/ connection - see work/design/part06-design-v1.md's 06-09 section for why) and is left as a 5250x2 manual exercise for the lesson text, same as 06-11b already does. This manifest therefore only exercises the zero-division/monitor/on-error/psds path. Reports via QMHSNDPM to the job log (not DSPLY), captured automatically by VFYLOG.
